announcements.instructions: Supervisor-authored announcements only (wave start/stop, new teammate, zone freezes). Assignments never happen here — they arrive by DM; state lives in the tracker. Read-only for workers.

svc.petrel.description: Petrel service channel — owner is first point-of-contact, reviewer, spec-owner.
svc.petrel.instructions: @mention the petrel owner for a petrel incident/bugfix; post a PR touching oss/petrel/** here on start. The owner (dormant) wakes on mention.
